narrative_lines.title: Design to Package with Onto2AI
narrative_lines.text: This demo shows the reusable Onto2AI workflow for designing, testing, and publishing a domain package. Entitlement is the worked example, and the final proof is the onto2ai entitlement package.

narrative_lines.title: Why Start with Ontology?
narrative_lines.text: Application teams often begin with code models, constraints, and API contracts. Without a shared semantic source, those artifacts drift and every team rebuilds domain meaning differently.

narrative_lines.title: Author the Semantic Source
narrative_lines.text: The Onto2AI method starts with RDF. We define domain concepts, relationships, restrictions, enumerations, and documentation before committing to an implementation model.

narrative_lines.title: Entitlement as the Example
narrative_lines.text: For entitlement, the ontology connects users, policy groups, policies, row filter rules, column mask rules, and the protected database, table, and column context.

narrative_lines.title: Inspect in Onto2AI Modeller
narrative_lines.text: Onto2AI Modeller loads the RDF into a modelling workspace where designers inspect the ontology graph, review class details, and refine relationships before generation.

narrative_lines.title: Review from Multiple Views
narrative_lines.text: Ontology View, UML, and application code model views make inheritance, cardinality, required properties, and enumeration choices visible before they become application contracts.

narrative_lines.title: Generate through Onto2AI MCP
narrative_lines.text: Onto2AI MCP turns ontology intent into aligned schema JSON, query context, Neo4j constraints, and an application code model. Pydantic is one supported target, not the goal itself.

narrative_lines.title: Enforce with Harness Modes
narrative_lines.text: Ontology Mode validates RDF syntax, URI conventions, and package mirrors. Schema Mode checks generated artifacts and verifies the selected ontology in stagingdb.

narrative_lines.title: Test Runtime Behavior
narrative_lines.text: Dataset Mode creates an isolated disposable database, applies constraints, loads representative entitlement instances, validates application topology, and rejects ontology-only runtime content.

narrative_lines.title: Build through Release Mode
narrative_lines.text: Release Mode reruns the live gates, aligns versions, builds the wheel and source distribution with uv, and inspects their contents before it can report success.

narrative_lines.title: Publish onto2ai-entitlement
narrative_lines.text: The final package contains the RDF ontology, generated schema artifacts, application code model, and reusable smoke test, independently consumable from the modelling workbench.

narrative_lines.title: A Reusable Onto2AI Method
narrative_lines.text: Entitlement is only the example. The reusable method is to model meaning, inspect and refine it, generate aligned artifacts, test schema and runtime behavior, and publish an independent domain package.
